name: pixelmill
features: Toolpath simulator cuts pixel programs like raster, spiral, hatch, concentric, pocket, lissajous, star and cityscape.
Running, pause, next program and start over control the endless run.
Nudge pad moves the target, and fill, flood, depth and fade toggles change the cut.
City views switch between 1-point, aerial and parallax.
Pen size picks 1, 2 or 3 pixels, clear wipes the plot, and save PNG downloads it.
